summary: All nine findings in scope were confirmed by code reading (the reviewer's e2e evidence stands; file:line pointers re-verified at HEAD 4354ff137b). The design follows roadmap 4.2 (rewrite certificates) and 4.6 (fail-safe planning): (1) every data-dependent rewrite made by the LMDB pipeline before Cascades (exact stored-term VALUES anchors, guarantee-based filter drops) records its assumption set on the plan, the pipeline decision cache keys HARD semantic dependencies on it (data revision + per-predicate guarantee contents) instead of soft evidence, and detached refresh refuses to run when the assumptions no longer hold; (2) the data revision becomes durable and monotonic (LMDB write-txn id) and is no longer max()-ed with the persisted synopsis version, so restarts cannot freeze cache keys; (3) exact-probe caches key on that data revision, never on the sketch rebuild identity, and are cleared by reset(); (4) packed cache hits are authenticated by the collision-proof packed plan identity (which already encodes path minLength and GROUP_CONCAT separator) rather than lossy TupleExpr.equals, and the two lossy equals/hashCode methods in the model are fixed; (5) single-flight family waiters must share the owner's concrete packed identity (same predicate as PlanEntry.familyMatches) and query templates must match predicateRangeVersion; (6) failed flights make waiters replan instead of inheriting a CompletionException, LmdbCascadesOptimizer falls back on any planner RuntimeException, and unsupported operators fail fast before search. The three NPEs are one-line null-tolerance fixes at the exact sites the compliance stack traces name. Every fix is independently landable; suggested order puts the compliance NPEs first and the assumption-certificate work (largest) last, after the durable data revision it relies on.

findings.title: LmdbPipelinePlanCache detachedTemplate NPE on VALUES ... UNDEF (List.copyOf with null)
findings.severity: S1 (any LMDB query with VALUES UNDEF whose plan is retainable fails)
findings.rootCause: core/sail/lmdb/src/main/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/sail/lmdb/LmdbPipelinePlanCache.java:413-436 detachedTemplate() copies every BindingSetAssignment row into `new ListBindingSet(List.copyOf(names), List.copyOf(values))` (:430). `values.add(bindingSet.getValue(name))` yields null for UNDEF, and List.copyOf rejects null elements -> NullPointerException in LmdbPipelinePlanCache$2.meet. detachedTemplate runs for every computed plan with `stable && retainable(computed)` (:181, retainable = optimizer.cascadesApplied=true, :396-398), i.e. practically every LMDB query that went through packed Cascades. ListBindingSet itself supports null values as 'unbound' (core/query/.../ListBindingSet.java:88-97), and PackedQueryCodec handles UNDEF rows (the NPE is the only failure), so the template copy is the sole defect.
findings.fix: Replace `List.copyOf(values)` with a null-tolerant immutable copy: `Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(values))` (ArrayList accepts nulls; ListBindingSet reads null as unbound). Keep `List.copyOf(names)` and `Set.copyOf(assignment.getBindingNames())` (names are never null). No behaviour change for fully-bound rows.

files.change: `rows.add(new ListBindingSet(List.copyOf(names), Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(values))));` (values list already built as ArrayList at :425-428)

findings.risk: None beyond the fix itself; the cached template then carries UNDEF rows exactly as the source did. Confirm PackedQueryCodec.rebindOriginalBindingSets / cachedBindingAssignmentUsesTheCurrentQueryRows still substitute the caller's rows (they do; the template rows are only a detached copy).
findings.recommendationReason: One-line fix that un-breaks every LMDB query with VALUES UNDEF (8 compliance errors) and unblocks the rest of this WP's LMDB e2e tests that use VALUES.
reproTestMethods: No dedicated repro method exists; the reproducer is the compliance suite (compliance/sparql LmdbSPARQL11QueryComplianceTest, 8x LmdbPipelinePlanCache$2.meet:430). Port: add LmdbPipelinePlanCacheTest#retainedTemplateKeepsUndefRows (unit, core/sail/lmdb/src/test/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/sail/lmdb/LmdbPipelinePlanCacheTest.java, modelled on retainedTemplateOwnsAnImmutableCopyOfBindingRows :299) and an LMDB e2e method in the ported LmdbPlanCacheUpdateReviewReproTest (core/sail/lmdb/src/test/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/sail/lmdb/) running `SELECT * { VALUES ?x { UNDEF <urn:a> } ?s <urn:p> ?x }` twice (cold + cache hit).

findings.title: LmdbPipelinePlanCache$DatasetIdentity.immutable NPE with null default graph (SPARQL UPDATE)
findings.severity: S1 (32 SPARQL 1.1 UPDATE compliance errors on LMDB)
findings.rootCause: core/sail/lmdb/src/main/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/sail/lmdb/LmdbPipelinePlanCache.java:501-503 `immutable(Set<IRI> values)` returns `Set.copyOf(values)`, which throws NullPointerException when the set contains null. A null graph IRI is the documented way to name the store's default graph in a Dataset (SailDatasetImpl.java:269 `deprecatedContexts.contains(null)`; the compliance harness does `ds.addDefaultGraph(null)` at testsuites/sparql/.../SPARQL11UpdateComplianceTest.java:114 and SPARQL12UpdateComplianceTest.java:96). DatasetIdentity.of (:493-499) is built for every optimized query via LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline.context (:168), so any update WHERE clause evaluated with such a dataset fails.
findings.fix: Make the identity null-tolerant while keeping value semantics: `return values == null || values.isEmpty() ? Set.of() : Collections.unmodifiableSet(new LinkedHashSet<>(values));` (LinkedHashSet allows one null, equals/hashCode stay content-based so the record equality used by PlanFamilyKey/SemanticDependencies is unchanged). LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh.dataset() (:185-193) re-adds the graphs through SimpleDataset.addDefaultGraph (HashSet-backed, null-safe), and Context.routingHash uses only set sizes (:591), so nothing else needs to change. Alternative with the same effect: explicit `boolean includesDefaultGraph` flags per set plus non-null Set.copyOf.

findings.title: PatternKeys.predicateKey NPE for a variable predicate with a constant object

findings.rootCause: core/queryalgebra/evaluation/src/main/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/query/algebra/evaluation/optimizer/PatternKeys.java:34-43: `predicateKey(IRI predicate, Value object)` dereferences `predicate.stringValue()` (:36) whenever `object != null`, but FilterSelectivityKeys.patternKeyFor (core/queryalgebra/evaluation/.../optimizer/FilterSelectivityKeys.java:69-77) passes `predicateKey == null` for a variable predicate and a non-null `objectValue` for a constant object. findings.title: Lossy TupleExpr.equals authenticates packed plan-cache hits (p* plan served for p+, ',' separator served for '|')
findings.rootCause:
core/queryalgebra/evaluation/.../cascades/packed/PackedPlanCache.java:847-855 sameSource() accepts a candidate as identical to the cached snapshot when `snapshot.equals(candidate)` (:849). PlanEntry.matches (:473-477), QueryEntry.matches (:534-538) and Flight.matches (:568-575) all rely on it. The routing fingerprint (ShapeFingerprint :308-372) hashes only class names, var names/kinds and BindingSetAssignment names, never operator parameters, so `?s

* ?o` and `?s

+ ?o` get the same Fingerprint and the same Context, and the final authentication is TupleExpr.equals. core/queryalgebra/model/.../ArbitraryLengthPath.java:231-239 equals() compares subjectVar, pathExpression, objectVar, contextVar, scope but NOT minLength (field :40), hashCode :242-253 likewise; GroupConcat.java:36-38 equals() is `other instanceof GroupConcat && super.equals(other)` where AbstractAggregateOperator.equals (:47-57) compares arg and distinct only, ignoring `separator` (:23). A hit then materializes `entry.query()` (the p* PackedQuery) via PackedQueryCodec.rebindOriginalBindingSets(entry.query(), source) (PackedCascadesPlanner.java:829-833) - the codec DOES encode minLength (PackedQueryCodec.java:988-994) and the separator (:1278-1280), so the collision is purely in the authentication step. PackedQueryCacheIdentity.create(source) (PackedCascadesPlanner:198) returns null when the query has no anonymous variables (PackedQueryCacheIdentity.java:33-39), which is exactly the p*/p+ and GROUP_CONCAT cases, so the identity fallback in sameSource (:851-854) never engages and equals is the sole gate.
findings.fix: Two independent changes, both needed. (A) Model: ArbitraryLengthPath.equals adds `&& minLength == o.getMinLength()` and hashCode mixes `Long.hashCode(minLength)`; GroupConcat.equals becomes `other instanceof GroupConcat o && super.equals(other) && Objects.equals(separator, o.separator)` and hashCode mixes `Objects.hashCode(separator)` (separator is a ValueExpr; ValueConstant has value-based equals). (B) Cache: authenticate with the collision-proof packed plan identity, not TupleExpr.equals. In PackedCascadesPlanner.optimizeWithCache (:198) compute `PackedQueryCacheIdentity.createPlanIdentity(tupleExpr)` (never null for codec-supported trees; canonicalizes anonymous names only when provably safe) and thread it through fingerprint/findPlan/findQuery/beginFlight/PlanEntry/QueryEntry; make the two-arg overloads in PackedPlanCache (findPlan :119, findStructuralPlan :127, beginFlight :147) use createPlanIdentity too. Rewrite sameSource to: `boolean identityKnown = storedIdentity != null && candidateIdentity != null; if (identityKnown && !storedIdentity.matches(candidateIdentity)) return false; if (snapshot.equals(candidate)) return true; return identityKnown && candidateContext.bindingShapeFingerprint()==0L && candidateContext.parameterVariant()==0L;` i.e. a known identity mismatch always rejects (fixes this finding even if a future model equals is lossy), equals alone is no longer sufficient when identities exist, and the existing alpha-equivalence path is preserved under its current guard. Optionally mix ALP minLength and GroupConcat separator presence into ShapeFingerprint to cut collision probing (not required for correctness).

equals compares separator with Objects.equals; hashCode mixes Objects.hashCode(separator)
default identity = PackedQueryCacheIdentity.createPlanIdentity; sameSource rejects on known identity mismatch and no longer trusts equals alone

findings.title: Single-flight family waiters and query templates reuse value-dependent recipes (EmptySet proof for a different constant / providerless planning)
findings.severity: S1 (planner-level, confirmed by unit repro; e2e window small)
findings.rootCause: (a) PackedPlanCache.Flight.matches (:568-575) admits a waiter when `sameSource(...) || familyIdentity != null && familyIdentity.matches(candidateFamilyIdentity)`. PackedQueryFamilyIdentity.matches (:104-108) compares only parameterSchema and canonicalPackedIdentity, which is computed from encodeForParameterizedCacheIdentity WITHOUT a range provider (:70), so two invocations of one family with different constants match even though their concrete queries differ in codec-seeded domain facts (PackedQueryCodec.seedStatementPatternFact :736-770 marks a group proven-empty when the constant is outside the proven range). PlanEntry.familyMatches (:489-496) additionally requires `query.hasSameCacheIdentity(candidateIdentity.concreteQuery())`; Flight does not. The waiter (PackedCascadesPlanner.java:215-220) then does cachedResult(awaited, familyIdentity.concreteQuery()) and materializes the owner's recipe (EmptySet alternative) over its own in-range constant. (b) sameQueryContext (:839-845) compares dataset/bindingShape/parameterVariant/catalog/dataRevision but NOT predicateRangeVersion (nor providerVersion). QueryEntry templates are PackedQueries encoded WITH range facts (encodeForPlanning(tupleExpr, rangeProvider) :151/:226-229/:423). LMDB plans dirty transactions with rangeProvider=null (LmdbCascadesOptimizer.java:136-141) and predicateRangeVersion 0 (cacheContext :356-368); findQuery then returns the fact-bearing template and `rebindOriginalBindingSets(queryEntry.query(), tupleExpr)` (:226-229) plans an EmptySet proof for uncommitted rows. The 1/16 segment routing (structuralQueryHash includes predicateRangeVersion, :204-210) only makes the collision probabilistic.
findings.fix: (a) One shared predicate for 'same concrete family invocation': add `PackedQuery parameterizedQueryTemplate()` accessor to PackedQueryFamilyIdentity (the field survives detached(), :91-97) and a static helper `PackedQueryFamilyIdentity.sameConcreteInvocation(PackedQueryFamilyIdentity stored, PackedQueryFamilyIdentity candidate)` = `stored.matches(candidate) && stored.parameterizedQueryTemplate().hasSameCacheIdentity(candidate.concreteQuery().withoutOriginalBindingSets().withoutInvocationParameters())`. Use it in BOTH PlanEntry.familyMatches (:493-494, replacing the inline check) and Flight.matches (:574). hasSameCacheIdentity (PackedQuery.java:149-160) compares relations/scalars/payloads/bindingSets/objects/symbols/metadata, which is where the seeded facts live; the withoutInvocationParameters normalization on both sides removes any dependence on the parameter vector (PackedQuery :95-110). (b) sameQueryContext adds `&& left.predicateRangeVersion() == right.predicateRangeVersion()` (providerVersion too if templates ever depend on the cost model; today they do not). Also make PackedQueryFamilyIdentity carry a boolean `rangeFactsSeeded` (rangeProvider != null at create) and refuse family matches across that flag, so a providerless waiter can never share a fact-bearing owner even if versions collide.

findings.title: Planning failure asymmetry: waiters get CompletionException, LMDB falls back only on IllegalStateException, unsupported operators fail after full search
findings.rootCause: PackedPlanCache.FlightClaim.await (:541-546) returns `flight.result.join()`; when the owner fails, Segment.fail (:645-649) completes the future exceptionally and join() wraps the cause in java.util.concurrent.CompletionException (no timeout either). PackedCascadesPlanner.optimizeWithCache (:215-220) lets it propagate. LmdbCascadesOptimizer.optimizeWithResult (:175-186) catches only IllegalStateException (PackedMemoInvariantException extends ISE), so the owner's query falls back to the pipeline-normalized tree while every waiter's query fails. Other planner failures are also not ISE: UnsupportedCascadesOperatorException extends CascadesPlanningException extends RuntimeException and is thrown by PackedPlanMaterializer.unsupportedBoundary (:225-229) only when the selected plan is materialized, i.e. after the complete search (PackedQueryCodec creates UNSUPPORTED relations for unknown nodes at :689-699; PackedQuery.supportsCacheIdentity :162-169 already detects them); IllegalArgumentException from PackedWinnerTable (:718-722, non-finite costs) and PackedCascadesPlanner (:739, certifier); PackedCostSessionFailure extends RuntimeException. The same CompletionException hazard exists for pipeline flights: LmdbPipelinePlanCache.getOrComputePlan (:165-171) does `shared.join()` after abandon() (:199-207) completed the owner's future exceptionally.
findings.fix: Roadmap 4.6. (1) Waiters replan: change FlightClaim.await to catch CompletionException|CancellationException and return null (document: 'null = the owner failed; caller must plan itself'); in PackedCascadesPlanner.optimizeWithCache, when `awaited == null` re-enter cache.beginFlight once (the failed Flight was removed by Segment.fail, so the waiter becomes the new owner and either succeeds or raises its own typed failure), never rethrow the owner's exception. Bound the wait: when limits.deadlineNanos() != Long.MAX_VALUE use `result.get(remaining, NANOSECONDS)` and treat TimeoutException like a failed flight (plan independently without publishing). (2) LmdbCascadesOptimizer:177: `catch (RuntimeException planningFailure)` (never Error); unwrap CompletionException for the reason; keep the WARN log and annotateCascadesFallback (widen its parameter to Throwable); every RuntimeException the planner can raise is a planning failure whose correct fallback is the already-correct pipeline tree, and QueryEvaluationException-class errors from storage would recur at execution anyway. (3) Fail fast on unsupported operators: in PackedCascadesPlanner after each encode (:151, :226-229, :423) `if (!query.supportsCacheIdentity()) throw UnsupportedCascadesOperatorException.packedBoundary(...)` using the UNSUPPORTED payload's recorded class name, before any search; PackedQueryFamilyIdentity.create already returns null for these (:85-87). (4) LmdbPipelinePlanCache:165-171: wrap `shared.join()` in try/catch CompletionException|CancellationException and fall through to `compute(computer)` (waiter computes its own plan; do not publish).

findings.title: Cache data revision stuck after restart: snapshotVersion() = max(in-memory counter from 0, persisted synopsis version)
findings.severity: S1 (committed rows invisible via cached EmptySet; sketch estimator on)
findings.rootCause: core/sail/lmdb/src/main/java/org/eclipse/rdf4j/sail/lmdb/LmdbEstimatorRuntime.java:406-410 `snapshotVersion()` returns `Math.max(storageAccess.dataRevision(), synopsis.snapshotVersion())`. storageAccess.dataRevision() (LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.java:77-79) is TripleStore.getDataRevision() (:394-396) backed by `new AtomicLong()` (:229) that starts at 0 on every open and is incrementAndGet()-ed per commit (:3415) - never persisted. synopsis.snapshotVersion() (LmdbQuadSynopsisService.java:129-131 -> QuadSynopsisSnapshot.snapshotVersion :83) IS persisted (QuadSynopsisPersistence:139) and grows by 1 per rebuild publish (:330-332). After a restart with persisted version V, snapshotVersion() stays V for the first V commits. Consumers keyed on it: PackedPlanCache.Context.dataRevision (LmdbCascadesOptimizer.java:359 -> PlanEntry.matches exact Context equality), LmdbPipelinePlanCache.Revision via capturePlanningRevisions (:352-359) and EvidenceSnapshot, the finite-surface scope cache (:371-376), LmdbEvaluationFilterServices contract epochs (:103-104). With Frontier OFF (repro config) the frontier revision does not move either, so nothing invalidates the cached range-EmptySet plan.
findings.fix: Separate the data identity from evidence identity. (A) Make TripleStore.dataRevision durable and monotonic: initialise it at open from the LMDB environment's last committed write-transaction id (TripleStore already reads `mdb_txn_id` at :2314 and :3340; take it from a read txn in the constructor/init) and on commit set it to `mdb_txn_id(writeTxn)` captured before mdb_txn_commit (:3400-3415, replacing incrementAndGet). LMDB txn ids are persisted in the meta page and strictly increase per write txn, so the value survives restarts and never repeats; Long.compareUnsigned ordering in PackedPlanCache.newerGeneration (:770-784) is preserved. (Alternative: persist a counter in the store's metadata DBI inside the same write txn.) (B) LmdbEstimatorRuntime.snapshotVersion() returns storageAccess.dataRevision() only. Fold the synopsis version into the evidence side instead: mix `synopsis.snapshotVersion()` into frontierPlanningRevision() (or leoRevision()) so a synopsis publish still moves PackedPlanCache.Context.frontierRevision / EvidenceSnapshot and triggers plan-quality refresh, without pretending data changed. (C) Audit the other snapshotVersion() users listed above; LmdbEstimateContextBuilder.root (:508) already receives dataRevision and synopsis version separately and needs no change.

findings.title: Stale data-dependent plans (exact stored-term anchors, guarantee-based filter drops) reused after commits; detached refresh replans from the already-rewritten source
findings.severity: S1 (rows missing after commit, permanently after refresh)
findings.rootCause: Mechanism: (1) LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline.computePlan (:112-116) runs the request-bound optimizers first; LmdbFilterSimplifierOptimizer replaces FILTER(?o=5) with an exact stored-term VALUES anchor (exactStoredTermFilterAnchor :429-462 -> LmdbEstimatorRuntime.exactStoredTermFilterAnchor :174-188 -> LmdbFilterSelectivityStats.exactMatchingDistinctValues COMPLETE enumeration of committed terms) and, with only spoc or when the guarantee makes the anchor exact, drops the filter based on knownRdfTermDomain (:1327-1335; canMaterializeObjectFilterAnchor :1345+, expandFiniteAnchor :1200-1233, materializedSmallLiteralFilterAnchor :1069). Both are facts true only at the planning snapshot. (2) LmdbCascadesOptimizer.optimizeWithResult clones `detachedPreparedSource = tupleExpr.clone()` at :174, i.e. AFTER those rewrites; LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline hands it to LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh (:128-139) whose execute() runs only PackedCascadesPlanner.refresh on that prepared source (:126-128), so a refresh can never remove the anchor. (3) LmdbPipelinePlanCache.publishDecision (:246-254) strips the per-predicate guarantee identity (PredicateRangeIdentity = RdfTermDomain contents per predicate, captured at :168 / :373-380 as SemanticDependencies.indexIdentity) via withoutIndexGenerationDependency() unless the PACKED summary declares PREDICATE_RANGE_DATA (PackedPlanDecisionSummary.java:106-109, derived only from packed rule proofs). Pipeline rewrites never set it, and the stored-term dependency (data revision) is not representable in SemanticDependencies at all (data revision lives only in EvidenceSnapshot = soft quality evidence, :382-397). (4) LmdbPlanDecisionCache.lookupVersion (:1620-1700): semantic deps match -> data drift merely makes evidenceStable=false -> UseAndRefresh('outside-stability-envelope') at :1687-1698 when expectedRegret <= bound -> LmdbPipelinePlanCache serves the stale champion (:135-142); the refresh then publishes the same anchored plan (publishRefresh :1224+), making it permanent. (5) LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh.ensureSemanticsCurrent (:170-173) compares predicateRangeVersion = hash of TripleStore.effectiveRdfTermDomainsVersion (LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.java:246-256; TripleStore.java:434-448 = encoding constant + exclusion config + disabled/unreadable flags), which no commit changes; the contents identity exists (PredicateRangeIdentity) but is only enforced when the packed summary is range-dependent (:148-152).
findings.fix: Roadmap 4.2, scoped to caches: record each data-dependent rewrite's assumption set and key the decision cache on it as a HARD semantic dependency. (1) New core/sail/lmdb LmdbPlanAssumptions (record: boolean committedSnapshotDependent, Set<IRI> guaranteePredicates) with `static LmdbPlanAssumptions collect(TupleExpr plan, PackedPlanDecisionSummary summary, PredicateRangeIdentity context)`. Sources: LmdbFilterSimplifierOptimizer stamps two dedicated metrics on every anchor it creates - `optimizer.planAssumption.committedSnapshot=true` for exact stored-term anchors (:455-460, next to the FILTER_IN_TO_VALUES proof) and `optimizer.planAssumption.guaranteePredicate=<iri>` wherever knownRdfTermDomain was consulted to drop or exactify a filter (annotateFiniteAnchor :1244-1258 already stamps OPTIMIZER_GUARANTEE_ANCHOR_PREDICATE; expandFiniteAnchor/canMaterializeObjectFilterAnchor callers must stamp too); packed PREDICATE_RANGE_DATA in the summary marks all predicates of the context identity as guarantee dependencies. (2) LmdbPipelinePlanCache: semanticDependencies(Context) (:373-380) builds the dependency with indexGeneration = context.revision().planningRevisions().dataRevision() and indexIdentity = predicateRangeIdentity (dependent=true); publishDecision (:246-254) then narrows per assumptions: committedSnapshotDependent -> keep as is (data revision + guarantee contents are hard: any commit -> matchesCurrent false at :1628 -> replan('semantic-dependency-mismatch')); only guaranteePredicates non-empty -> `withIndexGenerationDependency(0L, predicateRangeIdentity)` (contents-only, unchanged data revision tolerance); neither -> withoutIndexGenerationDependency() (today's behaviour for data-independent plans, preserving UseAndRefresh across commits). matchesCurrent (:255-268) compares indexGeneration only for dependent versions, so the lookup side needs no branching. (3) LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh: constructor takes the LmdbPlanAssumptions and the build data revision; ensureSemanticsCurrent also throws when committedSnapshotDependent && runtime.snapshotVersion() != buildDataRevision; `predicateRangeDependent` (:148) = summary-dependent || !guaranteePredicates.isEmpty(); the RefreshComputation index fields (:159-161) are computed with the same rule as publishDecision so the refreshed FamilyVersion keeps the hard dependency. LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline passes the assumptions into the refresh (:131-139) and into PlanComputation. (4) Because assumptions are collected from metrics, LmdbCascadesOptimizer.installSelectedPlan must preserve planned metrics on anchors it re-materializes (it already copies BindingSetAssignment rows; verify the metric survives PackedPlanMaterializer - if not, collect assumptions from the pre-Cascades tree in computePlan right after the request-bound optimizers and pass them down explicitly, which is simpler and immune to materialization). Deferred option (larger): make detached refresh start from the pre-rewrite source by cloning `tupleExpr` before :113 and re-running requestBoundOptimizerList() against the detached snapshot inside LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh; with (2)+(3) a refresh can never run on stale assumptions, so this is a plan-quality improvement rather than a correctness requirement. Leave predicateRangeVersion as the guarantee SCHEMA version (rename or document); the contents identity is PredicateRangeIdentity and is now retained whenever consumed.

sharedInfrastructure: LmdbPlanAssumptions (new, core/sail/lmdb): a rewrite-certificate summary {committedSnapshotDependent, guaranteePredicates} collected once per optimized plan from dedicated planned metrics (optimizer.planAssumption.committedSnapshot, optimizer.planAssumption.guaranteePredicate) plus the packed PREDICATE_RANGE_DATA flag. Consumers: LmdbPipelinePlanCache (hard SemanticDependencies), LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh (ensureSemanticsCurrent + RefreshComputation index fields), and any future execution-time re-validation (roadmap 4.2). wp1 rewrites (3.1) should stamp these metrics on every data-dependent anchor they create; wp2's packed proofs already flow through the summary. Also shared: (a) PackedQueryFamilyIdentity.sameConcreteInvocation - the single predicate for 'same parameterized invocation' used by PlanEntry.familyMatches and Flight.matches; (b) the durable data revision (TripleStore.getDataRevision from LMDB txn ids) as the one data identity for PackedPlanCache.Context.dataRevision, LmdbPipelinePlanCache.Revision, the finite-surface scope cache and the exact-probe caches; (c) the fail-safe contract 'planner RuntimeException => pipeline fallback, failed flight => waiter replans' at the PackedPlanCache/LmdbCascadesOptimizer/LmdbPipelinePlanCache boundaries.
